led_side.quirks: legacy codes: 97=บึงกาฬ; สระแก้ว districts under 25; หนองบัวลำภู under 41; บึงกาล/อำนาจเจริญ/รัตนวาปี under parents; Bangkok old amphoe sequence; branch offices named after tambon (1051-1071)

td_side.district_codes: PROV_CODE (2-digit) + AMPH_CODE (2-digit within province); districts endpoint SP=LUT_Q_BND&SYS_ID=GIS5&PROV_CODE={prov}&AMPH_CODE={amph}
td_side.quirks: modern codes: 38=บึงกาฬ, 39=หนองบัวลำภู, 27=สระแก้ว, 37=อำนาจเจริญ

mapping_rules: name-first matching (codes alone are WRONG for Bangkok - LED and TD sequences differ)
cross-province name match handles province splits (25->27, 34->37, 41->39, 43->38, 40->43, 97->38, 71->70, 95->94)
tambon evidence: LED branch offices (named after tambon) mapped to the modern district containing that tambon, per LED's own get_tambon.asp dropdowns
aliases: spelling variants (ปทุมรัต/ปทุมรัตต์, ตะโหนด/ตะโหมด) and former names (บางปลา->บางเลน)
4 dissolved historical districts have no TD counterpart (see entries with td_district_composite=null)
